title: Canonical filtered-step derived-cohomology comparison
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $K$ a bounded-below cochain complex of abelian sheaves on its small étale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and $T$ an étale termwise hypercohomology presentation of $K$ [def-weil-pbc-termwise-hypercohomology-presentation]. Let $q$ be any integer. For every integer $p$, define $e_{p,q}:H^p((T.L).\mathrm{step}(q))\cong H^p(X,\sigma_{\ge q}K)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] as homology of the inverse of $l_q$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-restricted-sections-lift], followed by resolutionEtaleCohomologyIso for the explicit $a_q$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-restricted-augmentation]. The named resolution and invertibility lemmas supply only proofs, never arbitrary isomorphism data.
